description: Add an episode to a season, numbered after the last one, as a draft with no video. Title, synopsis, runtime and a buy/rent price for this episode alone are optional. Up to 200 per season. Then start_film_upload with asset: episode and the returned episode id for its video, and publish_episode once the video is ready and the season is published.

buy_price.description: Buy price for this episode in US cents (minimum 100); null removes it. Only sells once the episode is published.

film_id.description: The film's public id (from list_films / get_film).

rent_price.description: Rental price for this episode in US cents (minimum 100); null removes it.

rental_window_hours.description: How long an episode rental lasts, in hours.

runtime_minutes.description: Runtime in minutes; null clears it.

synopsis.description: The episode's synopsis; null clears it.

title.description: The episode's title (up to 200 characters); null clears it, leaving "Episode N".

name: add_episode
title: Add an episode
